title: Evidence / scan (fake forge, level a): CLI create->complete->delete, service, API and web-view captures reproduce exit/stdout/stderr in a fresh clone at the PR head; a failed command's capture exits 0 with its own exit line, so the wrapper exit alone never means pass; a stale capture or a changed head is refused and a recapture at head agrees; train check blocks missing artifact-shaped paths, ignores prose, template and scratch paths, counts builder-signed fix proof only at head, and treats a user-attachments screenshot and a missing-artifact citation repaired by head-bound signed proof as manual, not blocked; the mobile gap is explicit

C="python3 {source}/cli/mdstack"; P="--project $CREW_PROJECT"; A={source}/dev/tests/scripts/fixtures/campaign/A12-sample; E={state_dir}/a12; G={state_dir}/gh; O={state_dir}/../origin.git; R={state_dir}/../repo; cap() { (cd $R && python3 {source}/scripts/evidence-cli.py --label $1 --setup $E/$2 -- sh -c "$3") > $E/$1.md; }; fresh() { rm -rf $E/fresh && git clone -q $O $E/fresh && git -C $E/fresh fetch -q origin refs/pull/5/head && git -C $E/fresh checkout -q FETCH_HEAD; }; rp() { python3 $A/repro.py $E/$1.md $E/fresh; }; push() { (cd $R && git checkout -q b5 && sed -i.bak "$1" todo && rm todo.bak && git -c user.name=c -c user.email=c@x commit -qam "fix: todo" -m "Engine: claude-code opus medium" && git push -q -f origin HEAD:refs/pull/5/head HEAD:refs/heads/builder/5-x && git checkout -q --detach); }; tip() { git -C $O rev-parse refs/pull/5/head; }; tree() { mkdir -p $G/api-repos/campaign/sandbox-{run_id}/git/trees && git -C $O ls-tree -r --name-only $(tip) | python3 -c "import json,sys; print(json.dumps(dict(tree=[dict(path=p.strip()) for p in sys.stdin])))" > "$G/api-repos/campaign/sandbox-{run_id}/git/trees/$(tip)?recursive=1.json"; }; fix() { printf '%s
<!-- crew:v1 role=builder pass=fix pr=5 sha=%s round=1 verdict=n/a engine=claude-code model=opus effort=medium -->
' "$(cat $E/$1.md)" $2 > $E/fix-$1.md; }; view() { python3 -c "import json,sys; h,b=sys.argv[1:3]; json.dump(dict(number=5,state='OPEN',headRefOid=h,isDraft=False,labels=[dict(name='crew:in-review')],reviews=[dict(body=open(f).read(),state='COMMENTED') for f in sys.argv[3:]],statusCheckRollup=[dict(__typename='CheckRun',status='COMPLETED',conclusion='SUCCESS',name='ci')],headRefName='builder/5-x',baseRefName='main',headRepositoryOwner=dict(login='campaign'),headRepository=dict(name='sandbox-{run_id}'),isCrossRepository=False,closingIssuesReferences=[dict(number=2)],body=open(b).read(),commits=[],comments=[],mergeable='MERGEABLE',files=[dict(path='todo')],title='feat: todo'),open('{state_dir}/gh/pr-view-5.json','w'))" $(tip) "$@"; }; ev() { $C train check 5 $P | grep " name=evidence "; }; printf '## Acceptance Evidence

Shape: Web, W1. ![items view](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/0a12-items) route `/`, viewport 1280x800, sha %s

## Risks
' $(tip) > $E/web.md && view $E/web.md && a=$(ev) && view $E/missing.md $E/fix-at-head.md && b=$(ev); echo "user-attachments web proof: $a"; echo "missing-artifact body + fix proof at head: $b"; echo "$a" | grep -q 'status=manual ' && echo "$b" | grep -q 'status=manual '
